description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Barbariccia v2)], [Wind Resonance +5% Boost]

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Barbariccia v2)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Wind Cutter when Damage Reduction Barrier is consumed, increases Wind Ability damage by 10/15/20/25/30% when Dual Wind Cutter has been cast 1/2/3/4/5+ times

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Barbariccia v2)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Barbariccia v2)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Dual Whirlwind Mode] and [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] when status is removed

description.name: Dual Whirlwind Mode
description.text: Casts [Dual Wind Barrier] when any damage reduction barrier is removed, max 4

description.name: Dual Wind Barrier
description.text: Grants [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: 10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 10% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
